title: Prawn and Tofu Sliders with Sesame Mayonnaise
changes_from_base: Chopped prawns, part of them worked to a paste, are bound with crumbled tofu, garlic, ginger, spring onion and a spoonful of miso-sesame mayonnaise, pan-fried as small thin patties and served with shredded cabbage and pickles.
summary: These soft, umami-rich patties blend sweet prawns with silky tofu and pungent miso, coated in a delicate sesame mayo.

ingredients.item: raw king prawns, peeled and deveined
firm tofu, crumbled and pressed dry in kitchen paper
fine sea salt or table salt

steps.title: Paste
steps.text: Chop a quarter of 450 g raw king prawns very finely to a coarse paste and put in a medium bowl; finely chop the rest and add with 115 g crumbled firm tofu pressed dry in kitchen paper, 4 tbsp finely chopped spring onions, 3 very finely chopped garlic cloves, 2 tsp finely chopped fresh ginger and ½ tsp salt.

steps.title: Mayo
steps.text: Mash 1 tbsp white miso, 1 tbsp toasted sesame oil and 2 tbsp mayonnaise until smooth in a small bowl, then whisk in the rest of 225 g mayonnaise; mix 4 tbsp of it into the prawn mixture, mashing well, and keep the rest for serving.

steps.title: Shape
steps.text: Press the mixture firmly into 12 patties about 6 cm across and 6 mm thick with damp hands.

steps.title: Chill
steps.text: Cook the patties straight away, or chill them for up to a few hours first.

steps.title: Fry
steps.text: Heat 2 tbsp neutral oil in a large non-stick frying pan over medium-low, cook 6 patties for 2-3 min per side until golden, opaque throughout and 63 °C in the centre; transfer to a large plate.

steps.title: Repeat
steps.text: Repeat with the remaining 2 tbsp oil and 6 patties.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Spread the remaining sesame mayonnaise on 12 split slider bun bottoms, add finely shredded cabbage, a prawn and tofu patty, sliced pickles, hot sauce if using, and the bun tops.

tips: Chop a portion of the prawns finely to create a binding paste that holds the soft tofu together
Use damp hands to shape the patties so the mixture doesn't stick
Cook over medium-low heat so the exterior sets without the interior drying out
storage: The patties can be shaped a few hours ahead and chilled; cook shortly before serving and eat immediately whilst warm. Cool leftovers in a shallow container and refrigerate within 2 hours (within 1 hour on a day above 32°C).
